workflow.description: Gather product context, user stories, and technical constraints for the ticket
PM perspective: business value; Dev perspective: technical approach; QA perspective: testability
Define acceptance criteria, add technical notes, outline test scenarios
Update ticket with refined details, document dependencies, add estimates

examples.input: Refine our user story for the new dashboard feature
examples.output: Refined user story with acceptance criteria, technical notes, test scenarios, and dependencies

examples.input: Run a 3-amigos session for our API integration ticket
examples.output: Refined ticket with PM/Dev/QA perspectives captured, clear acceptance criteria, and test plan
